decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service remains distant from the firm's core maritime and ship management expertise, making discontinuation likely.
The superyacht crew recruitment service builds on established crew recruitment capabilities and maritime network, so it is likely to be retained.
The maritime education programme expands the firm's training offer and has already built a partner network, supporting its continuation.
Emissions monitoring and compliance services are close to the core business and have demonstrated successful delivery, so they will likely be kept.
The emissions compliance dashboard is a digital tool aligned with the firm's environmental and digitalisation strategy, making it likely to remain.
The emissions compliance cost simulation tool is similarly aligned with the firm's digital and environmental direction, so it is likely to be kept.
